name: text2video-energy-benchmark-cross-model
description: A cross-model benchmark that measures energy consumption and efficiency of text-to-video models, comparing compute/energy cost against generation quality. It evaluates trade-offs between energy budget and video quality across multiple models and configurations.
evaluation_method: energy_per_video (Joules) combined with video quality metrics (e.g., FVD/FID) to assess quality-energy tradeoffs
reputation: A practical benchmark gaining interest among researchers and practitioners focused on ML efficiency and sustainability for generative video models.
